parameters.query: SELECT s.*, us.max_per_source, us.max_total_articles, us.summary_tone, us.why_matters_focus, us.recipient_email, us.email_greeting, us.email_footer FROM sources s JOIN user_settings us ON s.user_id = us.user_id WHERE s.user_id = '{{ $json.body.user_id }}' AND s.is_active = true
INSERT INTO digests (user_id, status) VALUES ('{{ $json.body.user_id }}', 'processing') RETURNING *
UPDATE digests SET status = 'sent', sent_at = NOW(), article_count = {{ $json.article_count }}, source_count = {{ $json.source_count }} WHERE id = '{{ $json.digest_id }}'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, digest_id: $json.digest_id, articles: $('Build Email HTML').first().json.article_count }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT s.*, us.max_per_source, us.max_total_articles, us.summary_tone, us.why_matters_focus FROM sources s JOIN user_settings us ON s.user_id = us.user_id WHERE s.user_id = '{{ $json.body.user_id }}' AND s.is_active = true LIMIT 10

SELECT us.*, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('headline', a.headline, 'summary', a.summary, 'why_matters', a.why_matters, 'url', a.url, 'source_name', a.source_name, 'genre', a.genre)) FROM articles a JOIN digests d ON a.digest_id = d.id WHERE d.user_id = us.user_id AND d.status = 'sent' ORDER BY d.sent_at DESC LIMIT 1) as recent_articles FROM user_settings us WHERE us.user_id = '{{ $json.body.user_id }}'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, sent_to: $json.recipient_email, article_count: $('Build Test Email').first().json.article_count }) }}
